ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.20:1.0 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the total visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black central region spanning approximately 80% of the surface area. High-contrast white mottling and contiguous blobs are concentrated exclusively at the distal lateral tips (lobes). The right distal tip shows a larger, more contiguous white cluster with internal black punctate marks, while the left tip shows a more fragmented, linear white pattern along the edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (irregular peaks and valleys) visible along the outer 40% of both the left and right lobe trailing edges. The topography is significantly smoother in the inner 60% approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep trajectory from the median notch to the tips, with a slight increase in curvature (tapering) at the extreme lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal corners of both lobes, characteristic of localized surface colonization remnants.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least three distinct, thin, light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) are visible on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small semi-circular indentation (chip) on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately 15% of the distance from the tip to the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white pixel clusters at the tips are highly asymmetrical, with the right tip possessing significantly more contiguous white surface area than the left.
